Quality and Innovation

[Discover our Products][38]

[aoc_logo_white+tagline.png]

 

AOC is the leading global supplier of specialty formulations and solutions which enable customers to
create robust, durable, and versatile products and components for applications in Coatings and
Protective Barriers, Colorants and Visual Effects, Adhesives and Specialties, and conventional
Composites. With strong capabilities worldwide in manufacturing and science, the company works
closely with customers to deliver unrivaled quality, service, and reliability for today and create
innovative solutions for tomorrow. Partner with AOC, and we will work together to find the right
solutions for your business.

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

## Industries we serve

[

### Agriculture

Hexion’s innovative resin technologies enable controlled, slow-release fertilizers that improve
nutrient efficiency, crop yield, and environmental sustainability.

Read our case study

### Agriculture

][42][

### Automotive

Our high-performance resins and adhesives drive innovation in lighter, safer, and more
energy-efficient vehicles.

Read our case study

### Automotive

][43][

### Building Materials

High-performance materials engineered to improve strength, durability, and sustainability in modern
construction applications.

Read our case study

### Building Materials

][44][

### Coatings & Paint

Our advanced monomers enable durable, high-quality coatings with optimized performance and
compliance.

Read our case study

### Coatings & Paint

][45][

### Equipment Solutions

Integrated equipment and process solutions designed to enhance efficiency, reliability, and
performance in industrial operations.

Read our case study

### Equipment Solutions

][46][

### Formalin

Essential formalin solutions produced with a focus on quality, consistency, and responsible
manufacturing.

Read our case study

### Formalin

][47][

### Mining

Our robust systems improve safety, efficiency, and environmental performance in the world’s most
demanding extraction environments.

Read our case study

### Mining

][48][

### Oil & Gas

Hexion chemistry delivers strength and reliability under pressure—enhancing drilling performance,
well integrity, and operational safety.

Read our case study

### Oil & Gas

][49][

### Wood Panels

Innovative resin systems designed to improve panel performance, productivity, and sustainability
across wood-based products.

Read our case study

### Wood Panels

][50]

## Science with Purpose, Sustainability with Soul.

At Hexion, we don’t make empty promises; we drive measurable, year-over-year progress to protect our
environment and empower the professionals who are behind it.

Shrinking Our Footprint,
Not Our Ambition

By prioritizing energy efficiency and circularity, we aim for measurable reductions in emissions and
resource use every single year, even if that means rethinking our legacy formulas from the ground
up.

With you anything is possible

We are looking for the curious, the bold, and the nerds who want to question the status quo. If you
are ready to grow, we provide the safety, well-being, and technical tools to help you reach your
full potential.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]

][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## [Appliances][123]

AltraSet provides materials engineering and compounding fully controlled by our in-house,
state-of-the-art laboratory. Our engineered composite materials have excellent performance
characteristics which makes them well suited for a wide variety of appliance applications.

[Learn More][124]

## [Automotive][125]

The use of composite materials in the automotive industry has gained ground in recent years. The use
continues to grow and AltraSet, a leader in thermoset compound products, meets the sophisticated
requirements of this highly-engineered industry.

[Learn More][126]

## [Civil Infrastructure][127]

Using composite materials in the repair and rebuild of aging civil infrastructure is an attractive
alternative to the heavier, corrosive materials traditionally deployed in the industry. AltraSet, a
leader in thermoset compound products, provides civil infrastructure composite materials for a
variety of infrastructure applications.

[Learn More][128]

## [Construction][129]

In addition to maintaining critical physical properties under a variety of conditions, construction
composite materials must be attractively finished with the end result lasting over time. As an
example, a window frame must maintain its color and gloss in all weather conditions and stand up to
harmful cleaning supplies.

[Learn More][130]

## [Corrosive Environments][131]

AltraSet, a leader in thermoset composites, produces corrosive environments composite materials for
some of the harshest industrial environments. Due to the anti-corrosive properties of composites, it
is the material of choice for these conditions since the 1940s. Advancements in the 1950s led to
composite utilization in the paper, pulp refinement and chemical processing industries.

[Learn More][132]

## [Electrical][133]

The electrical industry relies on the properties of electrical composite materials for top
performance. Unlike parts molded from plastic which can carbonize or melt during exposure to
electrical arcing or tracking, thermoset composite materials experience minimal impact from these
common electrical equipment conditions.

[Learn More][134]

## [HVAC][135]

AltraSet’s in-house state-of-the-art laboratory allows the company to fully control materials
engineering and compounding. The composite materials are manufactured with high performance
characteristics. This factor makes AltraSet products well suited for heating, ventilation and air
conditioning (HVAC) applications.

[Learn More][136]

## [Industrial][137]

Industrial products that include composite materials are lighter, corrosion resistant and require
less maintenance than products made with older materials like steel, cast iron or wood. AltraSet, a
leader in thermoset compounds, produces composites used in a variety of industrial products to
enhance performance and provide durability that lasts.
[Learn More][138]

## [Transportation][139]

AltraSet, a leader in thermoset composites, engineers and produces transportation composite
materials for original equipment manufacturers in the transportation industry. These materials
increase efficiencies, reduce fuel costs, and provide design flexibility and durability to the end
products.

[Learn More][140]

### Epoxy technologies

Advanced, superior custom formulated epoxy SMC for specific applications and performance envelopes

[Learn More][122]

## A True Renaissance of Materials Processing

Built on the legacy of Mar-Bal’s molding experience, AltraSet has the ability to custom design,
formulate, and manufacture a wide variety of composite materials to fit most any product application
or manufacturing process. We possess both the materials and technology to bring unparalleled
advantages to the equation for end-users including lower cost structure, higher performance, and
ease-of-processing.

## Applications of Composites

## [Appliances][123]

AltraSet provides materials engineering and compounding fully controlled by our in-house,
state-of-the-art laboratory. Our engineered composite materials have excellent performance
characteristics which makes them well suited for a wide variety of appliance applications.

[Learn More][124]

## [Automotive][125]

The use of composite materials in the automotive industry has gained ground in recent years. The use
continues to grow and AltraSet, a leader in thermoset compound products, meets the sophisticated
requirements of this highly-engineered industry.

[Learn More][126]

## [Civil Infrastructure][127]

Using composite materials in the repair and rebuild of aging civil infrastructure is an attractive
alternative to the heavier, corrosive materials traditionally deployed in the industry. AltraSet, a
leader in thermoset compound products, provides civil infrastructure composite materials for a
variety of infrastructure applications.

[Learn More][128]

## [Construction][129]

In addition to maintaining critical physical properties under a variety of conditions, construction
composite materials must be attractively finished with the end result lasting over time. As an
example, a window frame must maintain its color and gloss in all weather conditions and stand up to
harmful cleaning supplies.

[Learn More][130]

## [Corrosive Environments][131]

AltraSet, a leader in thermoset composites, produces corrosive environments composite materials for
some of the harshest industrial environments. Due to the anti-corrosive properties of composites, it
is the material of choice for these conditions since the 1940s. Advancements in the 1950s led to
composite utilization in the paper, pulp refinement and chemical processing industries.

[Learn More][132]

## [Electrical][133]

The electrical industry relies on the properties of electrical composite materials for top
performance. Unlike parts molded from plastic which can carbonize or melt during exposure to
electrical arcing or tracking, thermoset composite materials experience minimal impact from these
common electrical equipment conditions.

[Learn More][134]

## [HVAC][135]

AltraSet’s in-house state-of-the-art laboratory allows the company to fully control materials
engineering and compounding. The composite materials are manufactured with high performance
characteristics. This factor makes AltraSet products well suited for heating, ventilation and air
conditioning (HVAC) applications.

[Learn More][136]

## [Industrial][137]

Industrial products that include composite materials are lighter, corrosion resistant and require
less maintenance than products made with older materials like steel, cast iron or wood. AltraSet, a
leader in thermoset compounds, produces composites used in a variety of industrial products to
enhance performance and provide durability that lasts.
[Learn More][138]

## [Transportation][139]

AltraSet, a leader in thermoset composites, engineers and produces transportation composite
materials for original equipment manufacturers in the transportation industry. These materials
increase efficiencies, reduce fuel costs, and provide design flexibility and durability to the end
products.

[Learn More][140]

ABOUT US
**关于我们**
奥普锐特成立于2022年，选址于“皖南川藏线”的源头，在安徽省宣城市宁国市经济技术开发区港口永电智创城产业
园。管理团队吸引了热固性复合材料行业十年以上资深人员汇集制造、工艺、商务领域人才，服务团队集合热固性
复合材料业内10年以上专业技术人员。公司拥有专业的技术团队，引用行业里专业的设备及专业的检测人员，可实
现**定制化生产及销售BMC/SMC热固性复合材料**。
[
了解更多
][19]
[
Company culture
企业文化
][20]
[
Company honors
荣誉证书
][21]
**产品介绍**
**——**
复合材料一般都有基体材料和增强材料两部分（如树脂和玻璃纤维）。
由两种或两种以上单纯材料混合在一起并能有机地相互结合成一种新的绝缘材料。
BMC/SMC 是复合材料其中的一种是由不饱和聚酯树脂作基体和玻璃纤维作为
增强材料并结合其他必要的组分组成的。
**BMC 聚酯/乙烯基酯基团状模塑料**
——
BMC(bulk molding compound)或DMC(dough molding
compound)称为团状模塑料（以前也称BT-3），是一种团状的短切纤维增强热固性复合材料。如今在美国、日本和
中国,通常BMC和DMC是指同一种材料,根据美国SPI的定义,BMC 即为化学增稠了的DMC。
[
了解更多
][22]
**SMC 聚酯/乙烯基酯基片状模塑料**
——
SMC是Sheet Molding
Compound的缩写，即片状模塑料，主要原料不饱和聚酯树脂、增稠剂、引发剂、交联剂、低收缩添加剂、填料、内
脱模剂、着色剂等混合物浸渍短切玻纤粗纱或玻纤毡，两表面加上保护膜(聚乙烯或聚丙烯薄膜)形成的片状模压成
型材料及各种助剂组成。
[
了解更多
][23]
**产品特性**
Product Features
* BMC特性
* SMC特性
阻燃性和抗电痕性、优越的介电强度和耐腐蚀性、耐污性、超卓的机械 特性，极少的收缩率和稳定的色泽
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
表面易于粉剂喷涂，上漆和其它涂成技术。具有抗冲、抗压、抗弯
曲、抗拉伸，高电容量，高表面电阻，高绝缘强度，高耐电弧性，以及无毒耐腐蚀，阻燃等一系列优异
的物理性能
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
具有流动性好、模塑压力低、成型时间短、模塑温度低等优良成型特性
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
具有优越的机械强度、刚性、阻燃、耐腐蚀、尺寸稳定、抗紫外线、低比重等多种性能
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
我们每一个配方都根据您的需求特别订制，稳定的满足您对产品性能、加工性作的各种需求。我们开发出特殊的SM
C配方可使用注塑成型
根据您的要求，我们可以提供配方的UL认证、ROHS认证等多项认证及测试报告

ABOUT US

奥普锐特成立于2022年，选址于“皖南川藏线”的源头，在安徽省宣城市宁国市经济技术开发区港口永电智创城产业
园。管理团队吸引了热固性复合材料行业十年以上资深人员汇集制造、工艺、商务领域人才，服务团队集合热固性
复合材料业内10年以上专业技术人员。公司拥有专业的技术团队，引用行业里专业的设备及专业的检测人员，可实
现**定制化生产及销售BMC/SMC热固性复合材料**。

**产品介绍**
**——**
复合材料一般都有基体材料和增强材料两部分（如树脂和玻璃纤维）。
由两种或两种以上单纯材料混合在一起并能有机地相互结合成一种新的绝缘材料。
BMC/SMC 是复合材料其中的一种是由不饱和聚酯树脂作基体和玻璃纤维作为
增强材料并结合其他必要的组分组成的。
**BMC 聚酯/乙烯基酯基团状模塑料**
——
BMC(bulk molding compound)或DMC(dough molding
compound)称为团状模塑料（以前也称BT-3），是一种团状的短切纤维增强热固性复合材料。如今在美国、日本和
中国,通常BMC和DMC是指同一种材料,根据美国SPI的定义,BMC 即为化学增稠了的DMC。
[
了解更多
][22]
**SMC 聚酯/乙烯基酯基片状模塑料**
——
SMC是Sheet Molding
Compound的缩写，即片状模塑料，主要原料不饱和聚酯树脂、增稠剂、引发剂、交联剂、低收缩添加剂、填料、内
脱模剂、着色剂等混合物浸渍短切玻纤粗纱或玻纤毡，两表面加上保护膜(聚乙烯或聚丙烯薄膜)形成的片状模压成
型材料及各种助剂组成。
[
了解更多
][23]
**产品特性**
Product Features
* BMC特性
* SMC特性
阻燃性和抗电痕性、优越的介电强度和耐腐蚀性、耐污性、超卓的机械 特性，极少的收缩率和稳定的色泽
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
表面易于粉剂喷涂，上漆和其它涂成技术。具有抗冲、抗压、抗弯
曲、抗拉伸，高电容量，高表面电阻，高绝缘强度，高耐电弧性，以及无毒耐腐蚀，阻燃等一系列优异
的物理性能
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
具有流动性好、模塑压力低、成型时间短、模塑温度低等优良成型特性

具有优越的机械强度、刚性、阻燃、耐腐蚀、尺寸稳定、抗紫外线、低比重等多种性能
请输入要描述的内容进行内容补充
我们每一个配方都根据您的需求特别订制，稳定的满足您对产品性能、加工性作的各种需求。我们开发出特殊的SM

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

## EVENTS

[

### Lasers & Photonics Taiwan

#### August 19 - 22, 2026
#### 1F, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX), Hall 2

Join Coherent at Laser & Photonics Taiwan 2026, the premier annual event for the laser and photonics
industry, showcasing the latest advancements in advanced manufacturing, smart automation,
semiconductors, electric vehicles, and biomedicine. Visit us at Booth P502 to discover cutting-edge
laser solutions and photonics technologies designed to power the next generation of manufacturing
and industrial applications. Meet with our experts and explore how Coherent is enabling innovation
across industries.

Learn More
][67]

Companies 2026.

Proposed award will support new manufacturing jobs and expanded American production of critical

From Silicon photonics, VCSEL arrays, lenses, filters and couplers, and isolators, Coherent is a

# What we do

#### Thermoset Molding

#### Quality and Commitment

#### Thermoset Molding

  Elm Industries is a leading expert in Custom Thermoset Plastic Molding using compression, transfer
and extrusion tools. Thermosetting is a process in which plastic becomes irreversibly hardened upon
being cured. Curing is caused by the action of heat and high pressure, which results in extensive
cross-linking between polymer chains to give an infusible and insoluble polymer network. A cured
thermosetting polymer is called a thermoset.

#### The Materials

#### Quality and Commitment

#### Thermoset Molding

Elm Industries utilizes unique thermoset materials from suppliers that manufacture exclusively in
the USA. Elm specializes in the molding and extrusion of: **Glass and fiber-filled phenolics,
Diallyl Phthalates (DAP), Urea, Epoxy, and Bulk Molding Compounds (BMC**). Temperature, application
environment, and the material itself all factor into the construction of molds for these materials.
Insert molding is a specialty at Elm Industries.

#### Quality and Commitment

#### Quality and Commitment

#### Quality and Commitment

Parts molded for the military, aerospace, and electronics sectors, and other demanding applications
leaves no margin for error; every part must meet exact specifications. Fabricating and running molds
that are crucial to today’s industries, Elm knows the importance of product assurance and guarantees
the quality of every part that leaves our shop floor.



**MIL-I-45208 & MIL-I-45662 Approved Systems AS-9003 std | SPC Quality Assurance**

High-performance Electrical Connector | Diallyl Phthalate | Actual size .625” tip to tip

## Who we do it for

Elm Industries manufactures precision thermoset molded parts that are utilized in the most demanding
applications by the military, aerospace, and electronics sectors. Bearing testament to the quality
of our work is the fact that many of our customer relationships are years-, and in some cases,
decades-old. Let’s get to know each other and see where our relationship goes.

## About elm industries

### The People

### The People

### The People

  Elm Industries has a well-earned reputation as a leader in precision thermoset molding, the result
of three generations of Martin family involvement over the past 50 years. George Martin Jr. founded
Elm Industries in 1967, was soon joined by family patriarch and thermoset plastics pioneer, the late
George Martin Sr., and later by his brothers, son, and nephew, who each continue to play a part in
the continuing success of the business.

### The Work

### The People

### The People

Elm Industries sets the pace with industry leading technology and trends, breaking new ground and
innovating new ways to deliver products that exceed the demands of today’s applications. Elm
Industries specializes in insert molding, short run and hand mold work, prototyping, and product
development. Elm has designed, manufactured, and run plastic molds since 1967, earning the trust of
our customers for parts that are manufactured right. The first time.

### The Choice

### The People

### The Choice

Elm Industries’ extensive experience with precision thermoset molding ensures that your part will be
manufactured to exacting 

standards, including tight and zero tolerance requirements. The jobs we run are done right, and they
are done on time. Our quality control processes guarantee your complete satisfaction. Elm Industries
has received many industry awards for our high standards.

TRANSFER, COMPRESSION AND EXTRUSION MOLDING OF DIALLYL PHTHALATES (DAP), GLASS & FIBRE-FILLED
PHENOLICS, UREA, BULK MOLDING COMPOUNDS (BMC), EPOXY AND SILICONE COMPOUNDS PER ASTM D-5948 (MIL
M-14) SPECIFICATION AND GLASS REINFORCED THERMOSET SILICONE FOR NUCLEAR APPLICATIONS


MIL-I-45208 & MIL-I-45662 APPROVED SYSTEMS | AS-9003 STD | SPC QUALITY ASSURANCE

## FOR MORE INFORMATION ABOUT ELM INDUSTRIES, DOWNLOAD OUR CAPA

[Download PDF][5]

#### Elm Industries is a certified Veteran-Owned Small Business.

Elm Industries’ commitment to the plastics industry is embodied by their longtime membership in the
Society of Plastics Engineers, a trade organization for which George Sr. served as president in
1960.

applications by the military, aerospace, and electronics sectors. Bearing testament to the quality
of our work is the fact that many of our customer relationships are years-, and in some cases,
decades-old. Let’s get to know each other and see where our relationship goes.

## About elm industries

### The People

### The People

Elm Industries in 1967, was soon joined by family patriarch and thermoset plastics pioneer, the late
George Martin Sr., and later by his brothers, son, and nephew, who each continue to play a part in
the continuing success of the business.

### The Work

innovating new ways to deliver products that exceed the demands of today’s applications. Elm
Industries specializes in insert molding, short run and hand mold work, prototyping, and product
development. Elm has designed, manufactured, and run plastic molds since 1967, earning the trust of
our customers for parts that are manufactured right. The first time.

### The Choice

has received many industry awards for our high standards.

We design, manufacture, and assembly complete lines for cookware kitchenware hotelware, and cutlery

## Our Metalworking Machinery:

### Metal Spinning and Flow Forming Machines

Metal spinning is an ancient technique for shaping metal sheets into symmetrical, often hollow
forms. While the basic concept remains the same, the machines used for metal spinning have undergone
significant advancements. Today, metal spinning machines, also known as spinforming lathes, offer a
versatile and efficient method for producing a wide range of metal components.

**From Humble Beginnings to Modern Marvels**

The history of metal spinning stretches back centuries, with evidence of its use in ancient Egypt.
Early metal spinning lathes were rudimentary, relying on human power and basic tools to form the
metal. The Industrial Revolution brought about a turning point with the introduction of water,
steam, and eventually electric motors. These advancements enabled faster spinning speeds and the
ability to work with a wider range of metals, including brass, copper, aluminum, and even stainless
steel.

**The Rise of CNC Metal Spinning**

Traditionally, metal spinning has been a skilled craft requiring a high degree of hand-eye
coordination and experience. While the core principles remain the same, the introduction of Computer
Numerical Control (CNC) technology in the 1980s revolutionized metal spinning. CNC machines automate
the tool path, allowing for precise and repeatable production. This shift opened doors for:

## Our Metalworking Machinery:

### Metal Spinning and Flow Forming Machines

Metal spinning is an ancient technique for shaping metal sheets into symmetrical, often hollow
forms. While the basic concept remains the same, the machines used for metal spinning have undergone
significant advancements. Today, metal spinning machines, also known as spinforming lathes, offer a
versatile and efficient method for producing a wide range of metal components.

**From Humble Beginnings to Modern Marvels**

The history of metal spinning stretches back centuries, with evidence of its use in ancient Egypt.
Early metal spinning lathes were rudimentary, relying on human power and basic tools to form the
metal. The Industrial Revolution brought about a turning point with the introduction of water,
steam, and eventually electric motors. These advancements enabled faster spinning speeds and the
ability to work with a wider range of metals, including brass, copper, aluminum, and even stainless
steel.

**The Rise of CNC Metal Spinning**

Traditionally, metal spinning has been a skilled craft requiring a high degree of hand-eye
coordination and experience. While the core principles remain the same, the introduction of Computer
Numerical Control (CNC) technology in the 1980s revolutionized metal spinning. CNC machines automate
the tool path, allowing for precise and repeatable production. This shift opened doors for:

Certified to ISO 9001:2015 standards and UL E495715 traceability requirements, ECI’s meticulous
quality management system integrates advanced CAD platforms and 3D modeling software. Our engineers
can precisely analyze crucial mold design elements such as wall thickness, draft angles, rib
placement, and load distribution to ensure your end products meet all structural and strength
requirements. We can also utilize 3D scanning and modeling for quality verification and design
comparison.

Much more than a typical contract manufacturer, ECI can serve as an extension of your team. Our
comprehensive services seamlessly combine product engineering, tooling, molding, finishing, and
assembly within a single facility—the result: superior quality, consistency, and process efficiency
for your molded composites.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

masters. We are good at complicated mould, precision mould, and large mould making. And we also have

ABOUT US

Dongguan Hongke Plastic Precision Mould Co., Ltd. was established in 2008,as an excellent Chinese
manufacturer specializes in mould making and injection molding. We are involved in the field of aero
seats, auto parts, household appliances, power tools, medical equipment and etc. We have a strong
team of skilled and experienced mould design engineers, NC design engineers, and mould making
masters. We are good at complicated mould, precision mould, and large mould making. And we also have
rich experience in over mould, 2K mould, unscrewing mould, and high performance material mould.

We obtained ISO 9001:2015 quality system certificate. We have tens of processing and testing
equipment including high speed CNC machine, mirror EDM, precision grinder, lathe, milling machine,
drilling machine, tapping machine, injection molding machine and three coordinate measuring machine.

Our factory building area of 10000 square meters, More than 60 employees, Export about 400 to 500
sets of moulds per year.

## Innovative Solutions for a Sustainable Future

from natural, renewable feedstocks that provide the same durability and performance as traditional
composites. We also help companies implement more sustainable manufacturing processes that reduce
waste, pollution and CO2 footprint. Our goal is to help the composite industry become leaders in
sustainability through innovation.

[composites testing]

## Rigorous Testing and Analysis You Can Trust

We offer comprehensive testing and analysis services for composite materials and products. Our and
our partner’s state-of-the-art facilities are equipped to evaluate performance, durability, safety,
and certification to international standards. We test materials and components to determine
mechanical properties like strength, impact resistance, and fatigue life. We also conduct chemical
analysis to assess factors such as flammability and toxicity. Our rigorous yet cost-effective
testing gives companies confidence in their products and peace of mind in today’s global
marketplace.

[composites prototyping]

## Manufacturing and Prototyping of Composite Products

We offer high-quality manufacturing and fabrication services for composite product prototypes and
components. Our capabilities include most of the composite production methods and a variety of
composite materials. Innovellix’s manufacturing expertise and commitment to quality have made us a
trusted partner for companies in industries ranging from aerospace and automotive to pipeline and
construction. Let us build the composite components you need to bring your product vision to life.

courses cover the benefits, applications, and best practices related to composite materials, design,

introductory overviews to advanced technical instruction. Our training helps you gain expertise and
confidence working with composites. We provide opportunities for your team to learn from our
experienced engineers and instructors. Through our training services, you can keep your industry
knowledge and skills up-to-date and ensure you have the capabilities in-house to achieve your goals
with composites.

specifications, choose materials and manufacturing processes, and optimise designs for performance,
cost, durability, and manufacturability. Our structural designs help you achieve an ideal balance of
properties and benefits in your composite application. With advanced simulation and modelling
techniques, we can evaluate how our designs will perform and mitigate risks before production
begins. Our design experience covers a wide range of composite structures for industries like
aerospace, automotive, construction, and renewable energy.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## [Why Most SMC Molds Fail Before Reaching Their Expected Tool Life][3]

Why do SMC molds fail early? Master the physics of fiber abrasion, thermal stress cracking, and
shear edge wear to maximize compression tool life with MDC.

Tool life is one of the most important performance indicators in **SMC compression molding**. For
automotive exterior panels, EV battery enclosures, sanitary ware products, electrical components,
and structural composite parts, mold durability directly influences production costs, maintenance
frequency, part consistency, and overall manufacturing profitability.

Many manufacturers assume that mold failure occurs because of poor maintenance or excessive
production volume. In reality, most **[SMC molds][4]** begin losing performance long before they
become unusable. Microscopic wear, thermal fatigue, cavity distortion, and surface degradation
gradually accumulate until part quality can no longer meet specification requirements.

Understanding the primary failure mechanisms behind premature tooling wear allows manufacturers to
improve mold design, optimize maintenance strategies, and significantly extend tooling service life.

## Severe Glass Fiber Abrasion vs. Surface Hardness

One of the most common causes of premature **[SMC mold][5]** failure is the mismatch between glass
fiber abrasion and mold surface hardness.

Typical SMC materials contain approximately 30% to 50% chopped glass fibers. During compression
molding, these fibers flow across cavity surfaces under extremely high pressure while being carried
by the resin system. Over thousands of molding cycles, this continuous movement creates severe
scouring wear on mold surfaces.

Areas most vulnerable to abrasion include:
* Material charge zones
* Flow transition regions
* Rib structures
* Sharp corner geometries
* Parting line surfaces

If mold steels such as 1.2311 or 1.2738 are not properly surface engineered, the abrasive action of
glass fibers can gradually damage the cavity finish. Surface roughness increases, release
performance deteriorates, and dimensional accuracy begins to decline.

This wear mechanism often results in:
* Difficult demolding
* Surface defects
* Loss of Class A finish quality
* Dimensional inconsistency
* Increased maintenance frequency

To combat fiber abrasion, advanced **[SMC tooling][6]** frequently incorporates hard chrome plating,
precision polishing, and specialized surface treatments capable of achieving surface hardness levels
above 58 HRC while maintaining excellent release characteristics.

[SMC moulding]

## Thermal Fatigue and Stress Cracking from Poor Heat Management

Temperature control is often discussed from a product quality perspective, but it is equally
critical for mold longevity.

Most **[SMC compression molds][7]** operate continuously between 140°C and 160°C. During production,
molds repeatedly heat up, cool down, and experience thermal expansion cycles. If heating channels
are poorly designed or temperature distribution is inconsistent, localized thermal gradients develop
within the steel structure.

These temperature differences generate internal thermal stress as different areas of the mold expand
and contract at different rates.

Over time, repeated thermal cycling may lead to:
* Thermal fatigue micro-cracking
* Surface cracking
* Loss of cavity precision
* Localized distortion
* Premature mold refurbishment

Large automotive components and EV battery enclosure molds are particularly sensitive because their
extensive cavity surfaces make uniform temperature control more difficult.

Modern mold engineering increasingly relies on thermal simulation, optimized heating channel
layouts, and zoned temperature control systems to minimize thermal stress and maximize tool life.

## Shear Edge Micro-Chipping from Clamping Misalignment

The shear edge is one of the most critical and highly stressed features in an **[SMC compression
mold][8]**.

In many automotive applications, shear edge clearances typically range between 0.03 mm and 0.05 mm.
These extremely tight tolerances are necessary to control flash generation and maintain clean part
edges.

However, if press alignment accuracy is insufficient or guide systems begin to wear, lateral forces
can develop during mold closing.

Even small alignment deviations may cause the opposing shear edges to contact each other under
substantial closing pressure. Over time, this repeated impact creates micro-chipping along the edge
surfaces.

Common consequences include:
* Excessive flash formation
* Poor edge quality
* Increased trimming costs
* Part dimensional variation
* Reduced automation efficiency

To minimize these risks, high-quality molds utilize precision guiding systems, wear plates, hardened
inserts, and rigorous mold validation procedures before production launch.

## Venting Erosion and Carbon Build-Up in High-Volume Production

Venting systems play a critical role in maintaining both product quality and mold health.

During molding, the resin system releases air, moisture, and volatile compounds that must be
evacuated efficiently through venting slots and gas escape channels. As production volume increases,
carbon deposits and resin residues may gradually accumulate within these vent areas.

Blocked venting systems can lead to:
* Gas entrapment
* Burn marks
* Localized cavity erosion
* Pressure concentration zones
* Increased cleaning requirements

Proper vent design and routine maintenance are essential for preserving mold performance during
long-term production programs.

## Loss of Cavity Accuracy Due to Uneven Wear Distribution

Most molds do not fail suddenly. Instead, cavity accuracy gradually deteriorates through uneven wear
distribution over thousands of production cycles.

Certain regions experience significantly higher material flow velocity, pressure, and abrasion than
others. As a result, wear rates become uneven throughout the mold.

What begins as microscopic dimensional change can eventually develop into significant tolerance
drift.

Potential consequences include:
* Assembly issues
* Seal surface leakage
* Door panel gap inconsistency
* Battery enclosure fitment problems
* Reduced product repeatability

Regular cavity inspection and dimensional verification help identify these issues before they affect
production quality.

## How Chrome Plating and Surface Engineering Extend SMC Mold Life

Among all mold protection technologies, surface engineering remains one of the most effective
methods for extending tooling life.

Hard chrome plating creates an extremely wear-resistant surface capable of withstanding continuous
exposure to abrasive glass fibers and repeated molding cycles.

When combined with precision polishing, surface treatment provides multiple advantages:
* Higher surface hardness
* Improved release performance
* Reduced fiber scouring wear
* Lower maintenance frequency
* Enhanced corrosion resistance
* Improved Class A surface quality

For automotive exterior panels and high-volume industrial applications, properly executed chrome
plating often represents one of the most valuable investments in long-term mold durability.

[MRI mold]

## How Preventive Maintenance Extends Tool Life

Even the most advanced mold engineering cannot eliminate the need for preventive maintenance.

Rather than waiting for quality issues to appear, successful manufacturers implement proactive
maintenance schedules that include:
* Cavity surface inspection
* Venting system cleaning
* Guide system verification
* Wear plate inspection
* Heating system evaluation
* Periodic polishing and repair

Preventive maintenance significantly reduces unexpected downtime and helps maintain consistent part
quality throughout the mold’s service life.

## What Determines Whether an SMC Mold Lasts 100,000 or 1,000,000 Cycles?

The difference between a mold that requires major refurbishment after 100,000 cycles and one that
successfully exceeds 1,000,000 cycles rarely comes down to a single factor.

Long-term tooling durability is determined by the combined influence of:
* Glass fiber abrasion resistance
* Thermal fatigue management
* Shear edge protection
* Venting performance
* Surface engineering quality
* Structural rigidity
* Preventive maintenance practices

When these factors are addressed during the design and manufacturing stages, tooling can achieve
significantly longer service life while maintaining production efficiency and part quality.

## MDC’s Approach to Long-Life SMC Mold Engineering

As a professional **SMC mold manufacturer**, MDC focuses on engineering solutions that maximize mold
durability and production stability.

Our development process integrates:
* DFM analysis
* Material flow simulation
* Thermal analysis
* Structural rigidity evaluation
* High-speed CNC machining
* Precision polishing
* Hard chrome plating
* Comprehensive mold testing

By combining advanced engineering with strict manufacturing standards, MDC helps customers achieve
longer tool life, lower maintenance costs, and more reliable composite part production.

## Conclusion

Premature mold failure is rarely the result of a single defect. Instead, it develops through the
combined effects of abrasion, thermal fatigue, alignment issues, venting deterioration, and
insufficient surface protection.

Manufacturers that understand these failure mechanisms can make better tooling decisions and
significantly improve the lifetime value of their investments. For demanding automotive, EV,
infrastructure, and industrial applications, advanced **SMC mold engineering** remains the
foundation of long-term manufacturing success.

## [Parts of a Compression Molding Machine: Core Components Driving Composite Quality][19]

Explore core compression molding machine parts. Learn how hydraulic systems, heating platens, and
servo drives optimize SMC, BMC, and composite molding quality.

In modern composite manufacturing, product quality is no longer determined solely by mold design or
raw materials. The performance of the **compression molding machine** itself plays a decisive role
in controlling curing behavior, dimensional accuracy, mechanical properties, and long-term
production consistency.

Whether manufacturing **SMC automotive body panels**, **EV battery enclosures**, **BMC electrical
components**, or **FRP water tank panels**, every major machine component contributes directly to
the quality of the finished part.

For this reason, leading composite manufacturers no longer view a compression molding press as
simply a hydraulic machine. Instead, it is regarded as a highly integrated production system where
pressure control, temperature uniformity, alignment precision, and digital process monitoring work
together to eliminate defects and maximize production stability.

[compression-molding]

## Why Machine Design Matters in Compression Molding

Many common composite molding defects—including porosity, blistering, under-curing, warpage, flash
formation, dimensional variation, and inconsistent mechanical properties—can often be traced back to
machine performance rather than mold design alone.

Modern compression molding machines are therefore engineered not only to generate force, but also to
precisely control pressure profiles, platen temperature distribution, mold alignment accuracy, and
real-time process monitoring.

Understanding the relationship between machine components and part quality is essential for
achieving reliable manufacturing performance.

[Who is Mr. Tan - Your Trusted Sourcing Agent on the Ground in China]

## Who is Mr. Tan?

Independent sourcing agent based in Foshan, Guangdong. With over ten years of experience in the
e-commerce industry, including time spent at a Fortune 500 company, I have built extensive expertise
in dealing with manufacturers. I am now leveraging this background to serve as a professional [China
sourcing agent][20]. I truly hope to have the opportunity to cooperate with you, and I look forward
to proving my value through my dedication and sincerity.

[ More About MR. TAN → ][21]

## Why Overseas Buyers Partner With Mr. Tan

#### 1. Quality Assurance

I personally travel to the factories on the ground to inspect production lines and oversee quality
control. Your trusted eyes on the factory floor.

#### 2. Favorable Pricing

No middlemen and strictly refuse any kickbacks or commissions from manufacturers. My goal is to
secure the true ex-factory price for you, ensuring your products maintain a significant price
advantage in the market.

#### 3. Commitment

I won’t make empty promises that I am the “best” sourcing agent in China, but I guarantee that
absolute transparency and relentless sincerity are my unbreakable principles.

#### 4. Free Consultation

Complimentary, professional online guidance regarding China procurement, customs, and supplier
verification for overseas distributors.

MODULAR & STANDALONE SUPPORT

## Flexible Micro-Services Beyond Full Sourcing

In addition to our core end-to-end B2B sourcing agent service for bulk orders, overseas buyers can
also independently book these 3 targeted micro-services to solve immediate supply chain bottlenecks.

STANDALONE MODULE 01

#### On-Site Factory Audits

Independent field tracking across South China (Guangzhou, Foshan, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Zhongshan).
100% buyer-aligned verification with zero manufacturer kickbacks.

[Explore Audit Service →][22]
STANDALONE MODULE 02

#### Sample Consolidation & Lab Teardown

Consolidate multiple vendor packages in Foshan to slash freight bills by 50%+. Get hard-core caliper
testing and unedited video comparison reports before shipping.

[Explore Lab Service →][23]
STANDALONE MODULE 03

#### 1688 / Taobao Trial Order Bridge

Bypass local cross-border payment walls. Secure Alipay item purchasing, live warehousing photo
proof, and immediate domestic forwarder logistics integration for a flat $10 fee.

[Explore Buying Service →][24]

## Visualized Supply Chain Pipeline

A transparent execution roadmap mapping out how I manage risks, handle factories, and secure your
margins on the ground.

01
Intake

#### Client Consultation

Submit your product drawings, technical specifications, target pricing, or raw samples to benchmark
initial goals.

02
Dynamic Routing

#### Supplier Evaluation & Matching

Depending on supplier responsiveness and target feasibility, I dynamically split execution into 3
clear paths:

##### Path A: Existing Supplier Network

I will source, screen, and coordinate with suitable manufacturers from my [existing supplier
network][25] at MRTAN.NET to meet your specific project requirements.

##### Path B: New Supplier Sourcing (If Unsatisfied)

Should you be unsatisfied with our current suppliers, I will take full responsibility for screening
and sourcing new manufacturers tailored to your requirements, and manage all negotiations to
initiate the partnership.

##### Path C: Customized Supplier Sourcing

In the event that the required manufacturer is not currently in our network, I will immediately
prioritize sourcing and qualifying new suppliers that align with your specific demands.

03
Execution

#### Order Follow-Up & Production Tracking

Committed to closely monitoring the production progress and will provide updates on a regular basis
to ensure full transparency throughout the entire order fulfillment process.

04
Control

#### On-Site Sampling & QC Inspection

Strict random sampling on the live lines. Full unedited teardown, dimension verification, and
packaging checks sent to you before balance payment.

05
Logistics

#### Logistics Handling

My priority is to work with your preferred freight forwarder. If you do not have a partner in China,
I will obtain quotes from three different providers and present you with the most cost-effective
option for your confirmation.

🏁
Fulfilled

[Advanced Mold Manufacturing: Overcoming Complexity in Automotive Housing Production][192]

2026-07-23

As the automotive industry continues to demand lighter, stronger, and more precisely engineered
components, injection mold manufacturers are stepping up to meet the challenge. One such example is
the production of a large automotive plastic housing cover—a part that exemplifies the delicate
balance between structural integrity and weight reduction.   A Complex Geometry with High
Performance Requirements   This automotive housing cover features a large irregular profile,
reinforced with an extensive rib network, multiple mounting bosses, and numerous fastening points.
The design not only enhances structural strength but also ensures the component remains
lightweight—a critical factor in modern vehicle manufacturing. Typically molded from PP-GF30
(polypropylene with 30% glass fiber reinforcement), the part delivers excellent stiffness, heat
resistance, and long-term durability under demanding operating conditions.   Addressing the Core
Manufacturing Challenges   Producing this mold presents significant technical hurdles, primarily
centered around controlling deformation and maintaining dimensional accuracy across its large,

balance between structural integrity and weight reduction.   A Complex Geometry with High
Performance Requirements   This automotive housing cover features a large irregular profile,
reinforced with an extensive rib network, multiple mounting bosses, and numerous fastening points.

The Bonnot Company designs and manufactures ISO Certified custom single-screw extruders for
industrial processing of food, rubber, catalysts, ceramics, and specialty materials. Since 1891,
Bonnot has built a global reputation for rugged, low-maintenance extruder systems — with thousands
of machines in active service across industries worldwide.

ISO Quality Policy Statement ][93]
* About Our Extruders
  
  Since 1891, [The Bonnot Company][94] has dedicated itself to the production of extruders and
  extrusion equipment. Throughout our rich history, Bonnot has adhered to a ‘rugged’ design
  philosophy in the development of our extruders. We prioritize simplicity, low maintenance, and
  long-life designs, earning the loyalty of numerous customers worldwide.
  
  [Extruders][95] play a pivotal role in shaping various materials, resulting in a wide array of
  usable products. For instance, our food extruders contribute to the creation of breakfast cereals
  and pre-formed snacks, ensuring uniformity and quality through controlled pressure and
  temperature. Similarly, our food forming extruders are instrumental in crafting pet food and
  treats, maintaining consistency and quality for our beloved furry companions. These extruders can
  be employed independently or in conjunction with cooking extruders for unitized cooking and
  cooling processes.
* Catalyst, Carbon & Rubber Extruders
  
  In diverse industries, [catalyst extruder][96] machines find application in producing catalysts
  like high aluminas, gels, kaolin carriers, molecular sieves, and more. Bonnot offers extruders
  tailored to meet specific needs, whether it’s for producing minute pellets, solid rods,
  unsupported rings, or other catalyst configurations.
  
  [Extruders][97] play a pivotal role in shaping various materials, resulting in a wide array of
  usable products. For instance, our food extruders contribute to the creation of breakfast cereals
  and pre-formed snacks, ensuring uniformity and quality through controlled pressure and
  temperature. Similarly, our food forming extruders are instrumental in crafting pet food and
  treats, maintaining consistency and quality for our beloved furry companions. These extruders can
  be employed independently or in conjunction with cooking extruders for unitized cooking and
  cooling processes.
  
  Extrusion equipment extends its reach to essential components for home purification systems.
  Originally employed in the clay industry for de-airing products, vacuum extruders are now utilized
  to create [activated carbon][98]. This process enhances the carbon’s adsorptive properties,
  preparing it for use in various air and water purification applications. At Bonnot, our expertise
  spans a wide range of base materials beyond activated carbon, and our test facility stands ready
  to demonstrate how extrusion can work for you.
* Lab to Production
  
  Capacity serves as another distinguishing factor. For [substantial batches][99] and maximum
  output, a company might opt for a High Volume Production Extruder (Terrier), for instance.

  Extruders, suitable for producing and testing products in smaller quantities. The optimal solution
  varies depending on applications, volumes, shapes, and materials required for the task at hand.
  
  To embark on your custom extruder journey with The Bonnot Company, reach out to us. We collaborate
  closely with you to comprehend your goals and needs, offering tailored extruder recommendations.

  specialize in developing custom extrusion equipment to align with your specific applications.
  [Start your extrusion endeavors with The Bonnot Company today][101].

  **It is the policy of The Bonnot Company to provide our customers with products which are
  continually improving to meet or exceed their requirements in a timely manner.**
  
  We are also committed to complying with applicable requirements and improving the effectiveness of
  QMS. The responsibility to achieve these objectives is shared by all of our employees.

Our History

## over 130 years of extrusion engineering

The Bonnot Company was founded in 1891, initially serving the brick and clay industry. Over the
following century, the company expanded its material capabilities to include soap, food, rubber, and
industrial ceramics. Today, Bonnot is recognized as the global leader in extruders for catalyst and
rubber processing — two technically demanding categories where machine reliability and output
consistency are non-negotiable. The company's design philosophy has remained consistent: rugged
construction, mechanical simplicity, and long service life. Many Bonnot machines remain in active
production service after decades of continuous operation.
[ [Our History] Our History ][102]

## Frequently asked questions

What types of materials can Bonnot extruders process?
Bonnot extruders process a wide range of materials including food pastes and doughs, natural and
synthetic rubber, catalyst precursors (alumina, silica, zeolite-based), activated carbon, hydrogels,
ceramics, clay, and specialty polymers. The company's test facility can evaluate feasibility for
materials not listed here.
What is a single-screw extruder, and when is it the right choice?
A single-screw extruder uses one rotating screw inside a heated or cooled barrel to convey,
compress, and force material through a shaped die. It is well-suited to materials with consistent
viscosity and where continuous output is required. Bonnot single-screw designs are particularly
effective for pastes, hydrated powders, rubber compounds, and catalyst supports that require
controlled pressure without high shear.
Does Bonnot build custom extruders, or only standard models?
Bonnot builds both. Standard configurations are available across the lab, mid-production, and
Terrier high-volume product lines. Custom extruder development is offered for applications with
non-standard material requirements, output geometries, or process integration needs. Custom projects
begin with a consultation to define specifications.
What does feasibility testing at the Bonnot test facility involve?
Feasibility testing uses Bonnot's in-house equipment — multiple extruder types, screw geometries,
die sets, and material testing instruments — to process a customer's actual material. The goal is to
determine whether extrusion is viable, which configuration performs best, and what parameters
(temperature, screw speed, die geometry) optimize output quality.
How long has Bonnot been making extruders?
The Bonnot Company has manufactured extrusion equipment continuously since 1891. The company began
with brick and clay extruders and has expanded across food, rubber, catalyst, carbon, and specialty
materials markets.
What industries does Bonnot specialize in?
Bonnot's deepest specializations are catalyst processing and rubber processing, where the company
holds global market leadership. The company also has long-standing expertise in food extrusion,
activated carbon, ceramics, and hydrogel applications. The test facility supports exploration of new
market applications.

Bonnot's stated quality policy is to provide products that continuously improve to meet or exceed

compress, and force material through a shaped die. It is well-suited to materials with consistent
viscosity and where continuous output is required. Bonnot single-screw designs are particularly
effective for pastes, hydrated powders, rubber compounds, and catalyst supports that require
controlled pressure without high shear.
Does Bonnot build custom extruders, or only standard models?
Bonnot builds both. Standard configurations are available across the lab, mid-production, and
Terrier high-volume product lines. Custom extruder development is offered for applications with
non-standard material requirements, output geometries, or process integration needs. Custom projects
begin with a consultation to define specifications.
What does feasibility testing at the Bonnot test facility involve?
Feasibility testing uses Bonnot's in-house equipment — multiple extruder types, screw geometries,
die sets, and material testing instruments — to process a customer's actual material. The goal is to
determine whether extrusion is viable, which configuration performs best, and what parameters
(temperature, screw speed, die geometry) optimize output quality.
How long has Bonnot been making extruders?
The Bonnot Company has manufactured extrusion equipment continuously since 1891. The company began
with brick and clay extruders and has expanded across food, rubber, catalyst, carbon, and specialty
materials markets.
What industries does Bonnot specialize in?
Bonnot's deepest specializations are catalyst processing and rubber processing, where the company
holds global market leadership. The company also has long-standing expertise in food extrusion,
activated carbon, ceramics, and hydrogel applications. The test facility supports exploration of new
market applications.
What is Bonnot's quality policy?
Bonnot's stated quality policy is to provide products that continuously improve to meet or exceed

## INJECTION & COMPRESSION MOULD
* [[plastic injection mold]][43]
  Injection Mould
  Injection moulding is simple, melt plastic, inject it into a mould, let it cool and then eject the
  part, you got it. In reality, injection moulding is a complex process. To have successful parts,
  it will involve 3 participations, injection machine, injection mould, and the pellets that
  injected to the mould through injection machine.
  
  
* [[SMC Compression Mold]][44]
  Compression Mould
  Compression moulding is used in various industrial sectors. The excellent mechanical properties
  such as flame retardant make the composite very popular in making parts include hoods, fenders,
  panels, spoiler, doors, and battery cases in automotive. In sanitary industry, we were surrounded
  by object that were manufactured by composite due to it is surface aesthetics, water resistance,
  such as bathtub, shower base, washbasin, toilet.

## SERVICING THE AUTOMOTIVE, APPLIANCE, ELECTRICAL, LIGHTING, INDUSTRIAL, & ENERGY INDUSTRIES

[[Introduction to Woodland Plastics]][16]

## Woodland Plastics – Thermoset Plastic Injection Molding Fact Sheet

#### Company Overview
* **Specialization:** Thermoset plastic injection molding
* **Location:** Addison, Illinois, USA
* **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015; AIAG and IATF 16949-aligned quality systems
* **Production Scope:** Prototype through high volume manufacturing

#### Capabilities
* Custom thermoset injection molding
* Robotics and automation for consistency and efficiency
* Multi-cavity tooling for cycle optimization and cost savings
* Engineering support for design, tooling, and material selection
* Scalable production with audit-ready documentation
* Advanced statistical analysis embedded in quality systems

#### Material Advantages
* Heat resistance for high temperature applications (BMC, Phenolic, GF-PET, GF-DAP, GF30, GF50)
* Dimensional stability under mechanical stress
* Electrical insulation for connectors and circuit protection
* Long-term durability in demanding environments

#### Team Expertise
* Seasoned professionals with solid thermoset experience in:
  * Automotive industry
  * Electrical industry
  * Consumer goods industry
* Expanding focus into:
  * Electric vehicles (EVs)
  * EV charging infrastructure

#### Innovation & Sustainability
* Continuous process improvement initiatives
* Research into thermoset recycling and material re-use
* Supplier accountability and traceability systems

#### Quality & Compliance
* Audit-ready control plans and overlays
* Modular documentation for training and supplier onboarding
* Embedded statistical logic (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, p-values, regression overlays) for process
  monitoring

## As *Your First Choice Thermoset Molder*, Woodland Plastics Corporation Provides
## Custom Molded Thermoset Solutions for High Performance Applications
* Thermoset Injection, Injection-Compression, & Insert Molding Capabilities
* Materials Molded: Phenolics, Bulk Molding Compounds (BMCs), Epoxies, DAPs
* ISO 9001:2015 Certified Thermoset Molder
* Technology Integrated Manufacturer
